scope: two fresh daemon subprocesses, one pre-commit exit and one post-commit response-window exit
assertions: the daemon exits before SQLite commit and the same command_id can be replayed after restart
the daemon exits after SQLite commit but before the HTTP response and the same command_id returns the stored result
the test uses loopback HTTP and CLI daemon lifecycle only; no domain service is instantiated by the harness
limitations: job/materialization interruption and a full old-session matrix remain separate gates
the fault switches are test-only environment variables and are unset for normal daemon runs
